title: incident-bot: enhance oncall autodiagnostics with SLO-toolkit hints and runbook linking
author: Asha Patel
body:
Summary: Add SLO-toolkit driven hints and improved runbook linking to incident-bot's oncall autodiagnostics flow. This change enriches diagnostic suggestions with SLO context (error budget, recent burn rate) and surface prioritized runbooks with scoring signals from the SLO toolkit. Motivation: oncall signals indicate engineers need faster, higher-confidence guidance during SLO-driven incidents; this PR reduces mean time to acknowledge/mitigate by surfacing runbooks weighted by SLO impact and evidence.

What this does (high level):
- Integrates SLO-toolkit hints into the autodiagnostics pipeline (internal/autodiag/hints.go, pkg/slo_toolkit/integration.go).
- Adds runbook linking improvements: runbook metadata now supports SLO tags and priority scoring; incident-bot will surface top N runbooks with rationale.
- Adds opt-in feature flag enable_autodiag_slo_hints (config/feature_flags.yaml) and a rollout map for Dedicated customers.
- Adds integration tests for autodiag suggestions and runbook linking (ci/test-autodiag-integration.sh).
- Updates docs: docs/oncall-autodiag.md with examples and troubleshooting.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for new hint scoring logic
- [x] Integration tests for end-to-end suggestion flow (CI)
- [x] Feature-flag gating and config defaults
- [x] Backwards-compatible runbook metadata parsing
- [x] Metrics and tracing for SLO hint evaluation (metrics: autodiag.slo_hint.*)

Commits (summary):
- Add SLO-toolkit adapter and hint scoring (a19b2f6)
- Expose runbook SLO tags and priority score (d4c7f11)
- Feature flag and rollout config for autodiag SLO hints (3e0a4b9)
- Add integration tests and CI job (7f5d2c3)
- Docs: oncall autodiag guide and runbook examples (9c8b1a0)
- Fix flake in autodiag unit test (hotfix)

Files changed (high level):
- internal/autodiag/hints.go — implement SLO hint enrichment and scoring helper (approx. 280 LOC).
- pkg/slo_toolkit/integration.go — lightweight adapter to query SLO toolkit for error budget and recent burn-rate.
- internal/runbooks/linker.go — add SLO tag parsing and score-weighted selection.
- cmd/incident-bot/main.go — wire feature flag into startup and enable metrics.
- config/feature_flags.yaml — new flag enable_autodiag_slo_hints: false by default.
- web/fixtures/runbooks.yaml — new sample runbook metadata with SLO tags.
- docs/oncall-autodiag.md — user-facing doc and troubleshooting.
- ci/test-autodiag-integration.sh — CI integration test.

Review conversation (high level snippets):
- Miguel Rivera (reviewer): "Can we avoid an external call on the hot path? Suggest caching SLO results for 30s and include TTL in metric labels."
- Asha (author): "Good point — added short-lived in-memory cache for SLO lookups and exposed cache hit/miss metrics (autodiag.slo_hint.cache_hit)."
- Samir Gupta (reviewer): "Integration test flaked on the first run due to timing assumptions; please make the test resilient to async metrics."
- Asha: "Updated test to poll for expected metric and extended timeout; reran CI and green."
- Olivia Chen (approval): "Looks good to me. Nice work adding the feature flag and docs."

CI summary: initial run: build passed, unit tests passed, integration tests failed (timeout flaky test). Rerun after test fix: all checks passed. Checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), lint (pass), e2e (pass).

Performance and telemetry: added metrics autodiag.slo_hint.evaluate_count, autodiag.slo_hint.score_distribution, and tracing spans incidentbot.autodiag.slo_hint. No notable CPU/memory regressions in canary runs (+1.2% median CPU under synthetic load).

Backwards compatibility: runbook metadata parser accepts both legacy and new SLO-tagged formats; old behavior preserved if feature flag disabled.

Release notes: "incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics can now surface SLO-aware hints and prioritized runbooks behind a feature flag. Improves troubleshooting in SLO-impacting incidents."

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI.

notes_for_ops: Feature flag is disabled by default. To enable for a region: update config/feature_flags.yaml and restart incident-bot. Monitor autodiag.slo_hint.* metrics and autodiag.slo_hint.cache_hit for cache health.
qa_steps: Enable feature flag in staging and restart incident-bot
Trigger synthetic SLO burn (simulated service) and create an incident
Observe autodiag suggestions include SLO hints and runbook links
Verify metrics autodiag.slo_hint.evaluate_count increments and cache_hit > 0
